query: Create an LSC user story: a field sales rep records a sample drop to an HCP during a visit, captures the HCP signature, and the rep's on-hand inventory is decremented. Block over-disbursement and disbursement to an HCP whose license is expired. Priority P0.
expected_behavior: Asks the LSC sub-domain first and clarifying questions (via structured multiple-choice) before generating any story content
Uses the concrete persona 'Field Sales Representative'; the HCP is treated as the subject of the action, not the login persona
Acceptance Criteria use Pattern A (Given/When/Then), with the happy path and BOTH negative paths (over-disbursement, ineligible/expired-license HCP) as separate ACs, one When each
The 'records are created/updated' outcome includes a Pattern E block enumerating every object and every field (Sample Transaction create + Product Item on-hand update), with no 'etc.'
No Apex class names, IP versions/step numbers, SOQL, or API field names appear inside any Given/When/Then/And line
Includes a '## Technical Implementation (high-level)' section after the ACs naming components and cross-referencing AC numbers
Verifies standard LSC objects via salesforce-docs (or marks them proposed) and never invents *__c field names; greenfield custom components marked Proposed
Includes Definition of done (incl. >=85% Apex coverage since Apex logic is implied) and an Estimated Effort table labelled AI-estimated
Proposes saving the story under requirements/<PascalCase>.md
